text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm Daiwa Scarlet.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What I'm aiming for is to be the number one Umamusume!
I'll become the absolute number one,
beyond any shadow of a doubt in anyone's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: So you'd better work hard to be the absolute best Trainer for me, too, okay?!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
